solution: I am blind. On the back of my neck grows my brother's head. Since childhood, I have relied on my brother's guidance to live. But my defect caused my brother to have a mental breakdown. So one day, my brother gave me the command to keep walking forward. I gradually stepped backward, and my brother slammed into a sharp object, ending his painful life. Without my brother's care, I have no ability to take care of myself. So I know I won't live much longer...
canonical_facts: The narrator is blind and the brother’s head grows from the back of the narrator’s neck
The narrator has depended on the brother’s guidance since childhood, with directions reversed relative to their facing
The brother suffers a mental breakdown and intentionally instructs forward motion that makes the body step backward
The brother strikes a sharp object and dies
The narrator believes they cannot survive without this guidance; do not require that later death actually occurs
